entries.detail: createSession({mode,code,nick,color}) returns one Session over two interchangeable transports. Ops are applied optimistically and rebased onto the confirmed log order, so three clients converge byte-identically (verified over 67 concurrent ops and 524 ops). Locks are transactional (RTDB runTransaction / atomic table locally) with a 15 s TTL and onDisconnect release. Late joiners read /snapshot then replay ops after snapshot.seq. Placeholder or broken Firebase config degrades to local mode with exactly one console warning, never a throw.

entries.detail: The seven rejected pieces were never Blender models - assets/models/ was empty and the review page rendered src/model/proc-shapes.js placeholder solids (espresso-machine = procBlock(), literally one box: the czarny kwadrat). The generator defect is therefore fixed where models are actually authored: tools/blender/lib/build.py refuses to export any object whose parts do not form ONE connected body (union-find over part bounding boxes, 2 mm tolerance), and tools/blender/verify.mjs re-proves the same property independently from the GLB index buffer. That assertion caught 6 real disconnections during this build (reception desk work surface, kitchen carcase, fridge carcase, desk leaflets, and two more) that would otherwise have shipped. The chair placeholder yawed each base arm by -a while placing it at +a, so every arm pointed 90-2a away from its own castor - nogi w dziwne strony, found and fixed. 5 models have a bounding box that legitimately differs from src/model/catalog.js (tap above a basin rim, lever on a door leaf, pendant cord, bed headboard, and the dining table the reviewer called too small); each is declared in verify.mjs EXPECTED_DRIFT with the value the catalogue should carry. catalog.js is another agent-s file and was not touched.
